description: transformers' FineGrainedFP8 / DeepSeek-style packaging: the same element type and the same activation scheme as `cozy.fp8-rowwise`, and a DIFFERENT SCALE LEAF, RANK AND SPAN — `weight_scale_inv` is F32 [ceil(out/128), ceil(in/128)], one scale per 128x128 block, where the cozy rule has one F32 per output row. A reader that took either for the other would divide by the wrong numbers in the wrong places, which is why the two are separate identities rather than one handle with a flag.
inverse: W_bf16[r, c] = weight[r, c] * weight_scale_inv[r/128, c/128]
name: hf.fp8-blockwise
